authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Zoller explicitly derives Kohistani khaṭā̃v short from *khuṭṭa⁴ (CDIAL 3895), comparing Shina khuṭo and Kalam khäṭän. The survey Kohistani/Gawri forms and neighbouring Palula kaṭāno match this specific adjective family, including the nasal adjectival extension. Deaspirated and front-vowel variants remain qualified comparisons; the less transparent khaṛan and cɛṭan responses are excluded.
